literal_glyph_notes: p121 A2 final-row DVDAZ retains the printed noncoordinate Z-like glyph at source index 224 as Z; the analysis masks that one source slot. Reading it as a damaged X is a separately counted one-slot fill, not an observed-coordinate substitution.
The source grouping, native lengths and part labels are preserved. Part 1 of the Constanza inquiry is p121 B and part 2 is p122 A; page-local section letters are not silently unified.
limits: Earlier exploratory repository OCR candidates already identify these bodies; this is their source-audited edition with exact repairs, not a first-decipherment claim.
No published key changes, frame insertions, deletions, moves or numeral relabelings.
The reference Z A 1 K C in p121 A1 and G A 1 RM 2 ANG in A2 stay literal; no office or numeral interpretation is claimed.
The Constanza inquiry asks about communications and does not establish that the links were operational. The cash acknowledgment supplies no amount or transport route.
